scope: Offline host/compiled ARM evidence index for the pre-record continuation; no camera, RTOS, hook, firmware, RAM, partition, SD or power-loss execution.

entries.name: packet_custody
facts: failure freezes original bytes and rejects commit

entries.name: event3_normal
facts: AAC12/AAC25 loss and segment2 timing offset rejected by publication gate

entries.name: event3_close_failure
facts: original assert path is not safe recovery

entries.name: sdk_pipeline
facts: early copy, owned mux, codec epoch and writer joined
no concurrent dual producer, common A/V epoch, SD or camera integration

entries.name: capture_trigger
facts: voice START/STOP and shutter idempotence/recovery model
no GPIO/audio recognition/backend or firmware binding

remaining_gates: Install and quiesce real video/audio callback consumers with measured payload stability and cache ownership.
Keep AAC packets crossing a rollover until a legal mux boundary owns them; reject Close0 output when packet/time identity is incomplete.
Replace the stock assert path with a device-side recovery wrapper only after a separately proven native entry/recovery contract.
Prove common audio/video capture epoch, continuous one-minute spool, SD full/remove/power-loss recovery and real trigger delivery.
Run physical camera voice “开始录像”/“start recording” and physical shutter acceptance; offline trigger reducer is not device evidence.
